core_concepts: About the Author ANDRE AGASSI played tennis professionally from 1986 to 2006

Often ranked number one, he captured eight Grand Slam singles championships, tying him for seventh on the all-time list, and he’s the only man to win a career “Golden Slam” – all four Grand Slam singles titles plus th
He also compiled one of the best records ever by an American in the Davis Cup

As founder of the Andre Agassi Foundation for Education, he has raised more than $85 million for the Andre Agassi College Preparatory Academy, an acclaimed school for underprivileged children in his hometown, Las Vegas
He lives in Las Vegas with his wife, Stefanie Graf, and their two children
